what: Plan does not define how native review_core replaces REVIEW_CORE_*_SH bash stub injection
scenario_or_breakage: After review_core is in-process, build_review_core_env still points REVIEW_CORE_GATHER_CONTEXT_SH and siblings at executable bash stubs that review_core will no longer invoke; the listed review-core pytest matrix in python/test_review_pipeline.py will not exercise staged failures
suggested_fix: Add an explicit review_core testing contract: replace write_review_core_stubs/build_review_core_env/run_review_core with monkeypatch or injectable callables on review_pipeline stage functions (gather_context, dispatch_panel, collect_findings, check_reviewer_failure_threshold, aggregate/tally/emit façades, dispatch_voters); delete tests that read python/legacy_review_shell/review-core.sh source such as test_review_core_default_prune_nits_sh_points_at_skills_script
